messages:
maria: Quick pulse on validation UX for long console forms: prefer inline-only, or compact right-hand summary that appears on submit (anchors to fields)? Also confirm pattern for deletes: short typed token (\"DELETE\") vs checkbox + undo.

alex: hybrid vote: inline on blur + summary on submit. Summary helps when errors are off-screen.

leah: hybrid + anchors. Summary must be keyboard reachable and announce via aria-live.

sam: accessibility: use role=\"alert\" for submit failures, ensure summary items are real buttons/links that focus the field and add aria-describedby. Undo toast should be role=\"status\" and focusable.

jordan: required-field markers: avoid asterisk-only. Use explicit \"Required\" helper where it matters; faint asterisk elsewhere. Don't rely on color alone.

maria: deletion tiers idea: low-risk modal, mid-risk checkbox + 10s undo, high-risk short typed token (\"DELETE\"). Short token reduces friction.

aria-bot: preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/ux/validation-mini (feature flag enabled).

maria: Action items: alex -> SideErrorSummary PR; leah -> a11y checklist; sam -> add e2e aria-live assert; jordan -> run quick hallway test Monday.
